newsitem.title: UK: Crude tanker rates steady but markets becalmed.
newsitem.headline: Crude tanker rates steady but markets becalmed.

text.p: Crude oil tanker chartering rates were notionally unchanged for most routes on Friday with many brokers out of the market because of end-of year holidays.
A little fixing was seen in northwest European and the Mediterranean markets and rates were little changed but activity in the Mideast appeared very dull.
"You can safely say that nothing has happened," one dealer said, adding that rates were hard to assess because of the imminent change-over from 1996 to 1997 Worldscale rates.
Mideast/Japan rates for 250,000 tonne Very Large Crude Carriers (VLCCS) were unchanged at W62.5.
A large number of VLCC fixtures have been seen recently from the Mideast to Japan and to Asia, with a smattering of chartering seen to the U.S.
One broker said he thought Mideast/Europe rates for VLCCs were steady to slightly firmer at around W55, but this was rather notional.
